title: Gold-oil ratio z-score leads EEM lower
hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Gold-oil ratio 20d z-score > 1 leads EM equity returns lower by 2-3 days (-) as oil-driven risk aversion builds; trade short EEM 3d [finance.ratio.gold_oil -> finance.EEM.log_return]

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.ratio.gold_oil rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short EEM next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [risk-macro-em] Reversal control: gold-oil ratio 20d z-score > 1 is contemporaneously positive with EEM returns (r=0.32, lag 0), so a spike is a mean-reversion buy signal for EM by 1-2 days (+); trade long EEM 2d [finance.ratio.gold_oil -> finance.EEM.log_return] (parent: R2-0094)
